parent_objective: implement bounded history-sensitive active-set miner using history-intervention outcome degradation as acceptance criterion
blocked_by: M1575 design has not yet been implemented

public_gates: M1576 must implement bounded no-training history-sensitive active-set miner
M1576 must run only public smoke mining with the fixed P0 actor
M1576 must use wrong-history/donor-plus-hidden outcome degradation as acceptance criterion
M1576 must include current-frame substitution controls
M1576 must report source-family, window, variant, and control-substitution summaries
M1576 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the M1575 active-set miner that directly selects anchors by history-surgery outcome degradation rather than local forced-control flip alone
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public bounded mining implementation only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop after one bounded implementation smoke and route to audit
stop if implementation changes actor inputs or writes training corpus
stop if implementation omits current-frame substitution controls
stop if high-speed and late-reveal reporting is missing
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether gates pass or fail
if positives are source-singleton, classify scenario sampling failure before another repair
if controls dominate, classify current-frame substitution and block history claims
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1575 admits one bounded history-sensitive active-set miner implementation

admission_evidence: M1575 pre-registers source generation, donor pairing, history/control interventions, acceptance criteria, artifacts, and gates
allowed_updates: history-sensitive miner module and focused tests
M1576 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: source-family and window summaries are written

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1576 explicitly tests current-frame substitution via donor response/action stream, reset hidden, zero-current, zero-action-history, and zero-all controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If history-sensitive anchors remain source-narrow, control-dominated, or null, route to audit/synthesis instead of lowering self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: at most level2 history-encoded reactive evidence if source-diverse history surgery causes outcome degradation and controls do not dominate
no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded public miner can find source-diverse anchors where wrong-history or donor-plus-hidden interventions degrade closed-loop outcome more than current-frame controls.
success_criteria: focused tests cover acceptance criteria and summary gates
source-family and high-speed/late-reveal metrics are reported
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: implementation changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
implementation exports a training corpus or starts training/PPO
decision_rule: M1576 passes as implementation if it runs bounded public mining with clean guardrails and writes required metrics; it must still route to audit before materialization.
